en_title: Ubisoft Creates Generative AI Game Studio Called Motherbrain
cn_title: 育碧成立名为Motherbrain的生成式AI游戏工作室
opus_summary: 育碧成立子公司Motherbrain，专门将生成式AI应用于游戏。该团队曾开发可玩生成式AI体验《Teammates》，未来将研发游戏技术，包括拥有记忆的智能NPC和管理大型系统化世界的AI游戏主持人。

paragraphs.en: Assassin’s Creed developer Ubisoft has created a new subsidiary called Motherbrain, a studio dedicated specifically to the implementation of generative AI in games.
paragraphs.cn: 《刺客信条》开发商育碧成立了一家名为Motherbrain的新子公司，这家工作室专门致力于在游戏中应用生成式AI。

paragraphs.en: Ubisoft’s latest earnings report , published on November 19, 2026, included a segment explaining its new operating model. Part of this model is a subsidiary called Motherbrain, which focuses on “AI for gameplay innovation” to “support all game creators in developing groundbreaking experiences.”
paragraphs.cn: 育碧于2026年11月19日发布的最新财报中，有一部分介绍了其新的运营模式。该模式的一部分是一家名为Motherbrain的子公司，专注于「利用AI进行玩法创新」，以「支持所有游戏创作者开发开创性体验」。

paragraphs.en: Further down in its report, Ubisoft reveals that the developers at Motherbrain are also the team behind its first playable, generative AI experience called Teammates. This new AI-focused studio will “develop proprietary technologies for gameplay to empower creators and open up new possibilities for richer, more immersive and engaging player experiences.”
paragraphs.cn: 育碧在财报下文透露，Motherbrain的开发者也是其首个可玩的生成式AI体验《Teammates》背后的团队。这家专注于AI的新工作室将「开发用于游戏玩法的专有技术，赋能创作者，并为更丰富、更具沉浸感和吸引力的玩家体验开辟新的可能性」。

paragraphs.en: Ubisoft explains that Motherbrain is focused on creating “new player experiences, smart NPCs with memory, and AI game masters that manage large-scale systemic worlds.” Motherbrain was founded to “serve creators globally, both within Ubisoft’s Creative House ecosystem and beyond, and form partnerships with selected technology actors.”
paragraphs.cn: 育碧解释称，Motherbrain专注于创造「全新的玩家体验、拥有记忆的智能NPC，以及管理大规模系统性世界的AI游戏主持人」。Motherbrain成立的目的是「为全球创作者服务，包括育碧Creative House生态系统内外的创作者，并与选定的技术参与方建立合作伙伴关系」。

paragraphs.en: The existence of Teammates isn’t a surprise; Ubisoft revealed the project late last year, which some members of the media were able to play. It’s described as an immersive first-person shooter where players are accompanied by two robotic AI companions that they can order around using real-time voice commands.
paragraphs.cn: 《Teammates》的存在并不令人意外；育碧于去年年底公布了这个项目，一些媒体人士曾有机会试玩。该作被描述为一款沉浸式第一人称射击游戏，玩家会有两名机器人AI同伴相伴，并可使用实时语音指令指挥它们。

paragraphs.en: Speaking with VideoGamesChronicle , Teammates’ narrative director Virginie Mosser described AI as a “tool,” positing that it isn’t something that will ultimately replace entire swaths of the industry. “It’s a tool first. We’ve been working on it for more than two years now, and our conclusion is that it’s a super cool tool, but it’s still a tool,” she told the outlet.
paragraphs.cn: 《Teammates》的叙事总监Virginie Mosser在接受VideoGamesChronicle采访时，将AI描述为一种「工具」，认为它最终不会取代业内一大批从业者。她对该媒体表示：「首先，它是一种工具。我们已经研究它两年多了，我们的结论是，它是一种超级酷的工具，但它仍然只是一种工具。」

paragraphs.en: The reveal of this AI-focused studio, however, comes amid sweeping layoffs for those within the games industry. Just today, Ubisoft announced another round of layoffs , hemorrhaging 116 jobs across two of its major studios. And earlier this year, 40 jobs were cut at its Toronto studio, coinciding with a change in leadership with the exit of former creative director Clint Hocking.
paragraphs.cn: 然而，这家专注于AI的工作室公布之际，游戏行业从业者正面临大规模裁员。就在今天，育碧宣布了新一轮裁员，旗下两家主要工作室共流失了116个职位。今年早些时候，育碧多伦多工作室裁撤了40个职位，同时前创意总监Clint Hocking离职，领导层也随之发生变动。

paragraphs.en: Currently, Ubisoft is hard at work on the next generation of Assassin’s Creed games, one of those being Project Hexe , a highly-anticipated installment in the series set during the European Witch Trials.
paragraphs.cn: 目前，育碧正努力开发下一代《刺客信条》游戏，其中之一是《Project Hexe》，这部备受期待的系列作品以欧洲猎巫审判时期为背景。

paragraphs.en: News of Ubisoft’s new AI studio follows a few viral AI-related moments within the gaming industry lately; earlier this week, Embark Studios came under fire after replacing esports commentators on a highlight reel with its AI-powered characters from The Finals, and just yesterday, former Take-Two CEO Ben Feder said that the Western game market is just “ one Toy Story moment away from consumer acceptance of AI in video games.”
paragraphs.cn: 育碧成立新AI工作室的消息传出前，游戏行业最近发生了几起广泛传播的AI相关事件；本周早些时候，Embark Studios在一段精彩集锦中用《The Finals》里由AI驱动的角色取代电竞解说员后受到抨击；就在昨天，Take-Two前首席执行官Ben Feder表示，西方游戏市场距离「消费者接受电子游戏中的AI，只差一个《玩具总动员》时刻」。
